description.value: COBS Bread (Governor's Market Bakery) is a franchise location of the Canadian artisan bakery chain, baking all products from scratch on-site each day with no freezing or refrigeration. The bakery offers a broad range of fresh breads, loaves, buns, scones, cruffins, croissants, and savoury items including pizza. Leftover baked goods are donated to local charities at the end of each day, making it a community-rooted stop for cyclists looking for fresh bread in West Kelowna.
